issue_context.title: Windows fips debug build fails with "unresolved external symbol _BIO_printf"
issue_context.body:
Windows build with `enable-fips` and `--debug` options fails with `error LNK2001: unresolved external symbol _BIO_printf`.  The build succeeds if either `enable-fips` or `--debug` is not included.

This is new with the 3.0 beta1 release.  It was not an issue in the alpha17 release.

```
perl Configure VC-WIN32 enable-fips --debug
nmake
...
providers\fips.def(5) : warning LNK4093: Drive/Directory component ignored in 'LIBRARY' statement
   Creating library providers\fips.lib and object providers\fips.exp
fips.exp : warning LNK4070: /OUT:fips-3.dll directive in .EXP differs from output filename 'providers\fips.dll'; ignoring directive
libfips.lib(libfips-lib-ec_key.obj) : error LNK2001: unresolved external symbol _BIO_printf
libfips.lib(libfips-lib-ecp_nistz256.obj) : error LNK2001: unresolved external symbol _BIO_printf
libfips.lib(libfips-lib-ec_mult.obj) : error LNK2001: unresolved external symbol _BIO_printf
libfips.lib(libfips-lib-p_lib.obj) : error LNK2001: unresolved external symbol _BIO_printf
libfips.lib(libfips-lib-dh_lib.obj) : error LNK2001: unresolved external symbol _BIO_printf
libfips.lib(libfips-lib-dsa_lib.obj) : error LNK2001: unresolved external symbol _BIO_printf
libfips.lib(libfips-lib-rsa_lib.obj) : error LNK2001: unresolved external symbol _BIO_printf
libfips.lib(libfips-lib-ecx_key.obj) : error LNK2001: unresolved external symbol _BIO_printf
providers\fips.dll : fatal error LNK1120: 1 unresolved externals
Could Not Find D:\work\crypto\openssl-3.0.0-beta1\fips.*
NMAKE : fatal error U1077: 'cmd' : return code '0x1'
Stop.
NMAKE : fatal error U1077: '"C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2017\Professional\VC\Tools\MSVC\14.12.25827\bin\HostX86\x86\nmake.exe"' : return code '0x2'
Stop.
```
